title.en: An Act Declaring the 24th Day of September of Every Year as a Special Nonworking Holiday in Calamba, Laguna, to Commemorate the Birth Anniversary of the Late Speaker Jose Yulo, Sr.

text.en: September 24 of every year is hereby declared as a special nonworking holiday in Calamba, Laguna, to commemorate the birth anniversary of the late Speaker Jose Yulo, Sr.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, December 24, 1994.
